description: This collection records household experiences of container-based and other off-grid sanitation in Kenya, Peru and South Africa. The Scaling up Off-Grid Sanitation consortium collected repeated smartphone surveys from more than three hundred households, covering service use, wellbeing, income and disruptions. ReShare identifies January 2022–July 2023 as data coverage, within a longer 2020–2024 project period. ZIP deposits contain anonymised datasets and survey forms, with R preparation material and training documentation. Main data and forms require UK Data Service registration under its End User Licence; public metadata do not state charges. Documentation is openly listed. Removed household locations, incentives and varying survey participation are limitations for spatial or population inference. Modellers could parameterise sanitation choices and service-demand behaviour in agent-based simulations. model-epa-swmm is a complementary sewer-system resource, not a container-service model. No registration or restricted file access was needed for this metadata review, and no household records were downloaded.
